description: Write this account's History as the app does. Record a bet only when the customer says they placed it. report_advice_response: POST history/advice/response {reportId, reportDigest, expectedRevision, confirmation: SAVE_RESPONSE, input: {exposure, decision, claimedViewedAt, claimedDecisionAt, modifiedTicketId}}; read report_advice first, show the exact response to the customer and send only after their explicit confirmation; reuse commandKey on retry; save_manual: POST history/manual {id?, expectedRevision?, confirmation PLACED, input {ticketId, placedAt, status, outcome, ...}}; set_currency: POST history/currency app body; save_link: POST history/links app body (link an import to a manual record); recall_save: POST history/recall/organization app body (notes, tags, bookmark). Confirm the requested change with the customer before a write. A valid write is sent without a separate MCP preview unless the action says otherwise.

body.description: The app request body for this action, unchanged.

commandKey.description: Writes: one stable key per write, reused on every retry.
